tags.gist: Strongly supports CDRH's proactive, lifecycle-based framework for GenAI-enabled devices.
Says GenAI with robust oversight could save lives, ease clinician burnout, close diagnostic blind spots and widen access.
Strongly supports the competency-based model and urges streamlined pathways for uses such as radiology second reads, ambient scribing and lab analysis.
Wants scribing, EHR screening and supervised imaging second reads anchored in lower-risk tiers, with heavy scrutiny reserved for unmonitored autonomy.
Wants the safety escalation and quantitative analysis elements prioritized to prevent numerical confabulation in lab analysis.
Wants master files fully operationalized so downstream developers can use upstream model cards without exposing weights.
Supports enabling machine-based supervisory agents to help govern model drift.
Wants flexible PCCPs under section 515C to govern drift without burdensome supplemental clearances.
Asks FDA to advance the paper into draft guidance with streamlined pathways for clinician-supervised tools and an operational master file program.
